args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened an incident.

**What I did:**
1. **Diagnosed** — checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an 18% error rate.
2. **Identified the target** — the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy, but v2.3.0 is newer).
3. **Rolled back** to v2.3.0 in all regions — verified successful.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident** `INC-0001` for checkout-api, paging on-call, describing the failure and the rollback.

The service is now back on the last-known-good version (v2.3.0) across all production regions.
